articles.title: Tottenham in talks to sign Mykhailo Mudryk on a season-long loan
articles.summary: Tottenham are in talks to sign Chelsea winger Mykhailo Mudryk on a season-long loan.
articles.body:
Tottenham are in talks to sign Chelsea winger Mykhailo Mudryk on a season-long loan.

The 25-year-old is keen to play in the Premier League after resolving his doping case with the Football Association last month.

Chelsea have been in talks with Leeds and rejected at least one offer, but Spurs entered the race at a late stage after making attempts to sign Everton forward Iliman Ndiaye and Liverpool attacker Cody Gakpo.

They are now favourites to sign the Ukraine international, who has not played a competitive match since November 2024.

Spurs have also expressed an interest in Chelsea defender Tosin Adarabioyo.

Mudryk free to play after doping ban case resolved

The transfers to watch before window closes

Mudryk is understood to be open to a move to north London after maintaining a personal connection with Roberto de Zerbi, who managed him at Shakhtar Donetsk.

Mudryk joined Chelsea from Shakhtar Donetsk in 2023 for an initial £61m.

He was provisionally suspended after returning an "adverse finding" for banned substance meldonium in an out-of-competition test on international duty with Ukraine in October 2024.

He was subsequently given the maximum four-year ban by the FA but appealed against the decision to the Court of Arbitration for Sport (Cas).

However, he became free to return to competition "with immediate effect" on 31 July after the FA said anti-doping disciplinary proceedings had been resolved and that Murdyk accepted breaking anti-doping rules, also agreeing to a suspension equal to the time already served.

Mudryk, who has always maintained he "never knowingly or intentionally" had taken a banned substance, said he was "grateful" to be able to return to playing after "the most difficult period" of his career.

articles.title: Derek McInnes: Reduced touchline ban for Rangers manager
articles.summary: Rangers manager Derek McInnes has a touchline ban reduced to two games, with two suspended, following an appeal against punishment for comments made on a last-gasp Celtic penalty.
articles.body:
Rangers manager Derek McInnes has had a touchline ban reduced to two games, with two suspended, following an appeal against punishment for comments made on a last-gasp Celtic penalty during a television interview.

The 55-year-old will be in the stands for Wednesday's visit to Falkirk and Saturday's home match against Motherwell.

He will return to the dugout for the rescheduled visit of St Mirren to Ibrox on 9 September.

The original penalty of a four-match touchline ban, with one suspended, was issued in July and related to McInnes' spell as Hearts boss last season, when he described the decision to award Celtic a late penalty at Motherwell in May as "disgusting", adding "we are up against everybody".

The stoppage-time spot-kick for handball was converted by Kelechi Iheanacho and Celtic's 3-2 victory at Fir Park on 13 May kept them one point behind Hearts, who they beat to the title three days later in a final-day decider.

Rangers argued the remarks were "directed at the decision, rather than representing any broader criticism of officials" when announcing their intention to contest the ban.

At the same time, McInnes, said: "I've never wanted to make it personal. For me, the decision was wrong.

"Broadcasters pay a lot of money to hear managers' reactions. We've got to be careful that we don't have managers and players who have to be really sure of themselves and check themselves before answering a question.

"At no point was I wanting to inflame a situation. The situation was already being discussed before I did my press. It was quite a big moment in the season and there was a lot of emotion, but I felt as though what I said was controlled."

Rangers target Kelsy's colourful career - aged just 22

Is 'bitty' Pittodrie win turning point for McInnes and Rangers?

Visit our Rangers page for all the latest news, analysis and fan views

Speaking to Sky Sports after a win against Falkirk at Tynecastle on the same night as Celtic's win at Fir Park, McInnes said: "When you heard Celtic got a 96th-minute penalty that was going to VAR and they were checking it, you just assume what's happened is they get the penalty.

"Having seen it again, it's disgusting. It is. I don't think it's a penalty kick.

"But we're up against it. We're up against everybody."

Scottish FA head of referees Willie Collum later backed the call, citing "clear evidence" of Motherwell's Sam Nicholson's hand and arm "in an unnatural position" - and the resulting contact "a punishable handball".

The July statement from Rangers added: "Respect for officials and legitimate scrutiny are not competing principles.

"Managers, players and clubs must be able to speak honestly about major decisions if Scottish football is serious about raising standards and maintaining trust.

"Scrutiny, transparency and accountability should be seen as part of improving standards, not as a threat to them."

articles.title: Rubén Sánchez se marcha al Elche
articles.standfirst: El lateral del Espanyol saldrá traspasado al Elche a cambio de 500.000 euros
articles.summary: El lateral del Espanyol saldrá traspasado al Elche a cambio de 500.000 euros
articles.body: El Espanyol sigue trabajando a pocas horas del cierre de mercado. Una de las tareas que quedan pendientes de resolver era la salida de Rubén Sánchez, lateral derecho perico con el que Manolo González no contaba esta temporada. Tras varios rumores, el canterano finalmente será traspasado al Elche a cambio de medio millón de euros. Como han contado los compañeros de "La Grada', el futuro de Rubén Sánchez está muy cerca de resolverse. La salida del futbolista se había enquistado y a lo largo del verano había sido relacionado con equipos como el PAOK. Con el mercado a punto de cerrar, el canterano del Espanyol firmará por el Elche, lo que le permitirá seguir en nuestra Liga y jugando en la Primera División. Rubén Sánchez no entraba en los planes de Manolo González. Si la pasada campaña ya contó con pocos minutos, esta temporada no ha entrando ni en las convocatorias del técnico perico. Su pretemporada no fue buena y desde hace un tiempo se le veía más fuera que dentro. El propio Manolo González aclaró en la última rueda de prensa que no le veía para competir. Con esta operación, el Espanyol resuelve una de sus tareas pendientes en el mercado. La entidad perica se guarda un 25% de una futura plusvalía del futbolista. Con una ficha liberada, la dirección deportiva podría afrontar un último movimiento para apuntalar el puesto de lateral, pese a que Manolo González cuenta también con futbolistas de la Dani Jarque en los que se confía.

La operación llega a buen puerto después de varios días de negociaciones y permite al conjunto malagueño incorporar al futbolista que debía completar esa demarcación tras la salida de Dani Sánchez. Aznou llega a Martiricos con un perfil especialmente interesante para el Málaga. Pese a su juventud, ya conoce el fútbol español y cuenta con experiencia al máximo nivel. articles.title: España cae en Grecia y se mete en un lío mundial
articles.standfirst: Pierde en Atenas su tercer partido seguido en las Ventanas de clasificación para Qatar 2027
articles.summary: Pierde en Atenas su tercer partido seguido en las Ventanas de clasificación para Qatar 2027
articles.body: España se metió en un lío en las Ventanas de clasificación para el Mundial tras perder en Atenas ante Grecia 108-106. La derrota, la tercera seguida para la selección, complica la situación de España que al comienzo de la segunda fase era casi idílica y ofrece un balón de oxígeno a una Grecia que llegó asfixiada a este partido. España jugó un partido a ráfagas que igualó con un triple de Juancho cuando moría el tiempo regular. En la prórroga, tremendamente intensa, Grecia superó a una España que se lleva varias lecciones más de Atenas y que tendrá que enderezar su rumbo cuando lleguen las Ventanas de noviembre y febrero. España se tuvo que rehacer a un horrible comienzo. En apenas un minuto lo hizo todo mal: rebotes que le quitaban, balones que perdía, tiros que no metía y desajustes defensivos. Grecia aprovechó su mejor puesta en escena para adquirir la primera gran ventaja del partido, 8-0. La selección anotó sus primeros puntos (dos libres de Hugo), casi cuatro minutos después del salto inicial y se fue entonando hasta recortar la desventaja y acabar el primer cuarto por delante, 19-20. Para entonces Chus Mateo ya había puesto en cancha a Aday Mara que hacía estragos en la pintura griega. Mitoglou estaba jugando uno de esos partidos en los que parece uno de los mejores interiores de Europa. Llegó al descanso con 19 puntos, 11 de ellos en el segundo cuarto, y con un formidable 5/5 en triples. Pero Mateo encontró un quinteto que le dio grandes beneficios. Con Saint-Supéry, grandes minutos, De Larrea, bien en el tiro, Parra, Pradilla Y Baba Miller, que logró sus primeros puntos cn la selección a 8:49 en una penetración muy valiente, España logró meter algo de miedo en el cuerpo de los griegos: 21-27 a 6:37. Fue MItoglou el encargado de volver a meter en el partido a los locales y al descanso los helenos se iban con una mínima ventaja, 43-42. Mara seguía haciendo daño al poste y en ese momento De Larrea era el mejor anotador de la selección gracias a su 3/3 en triples. Tras el descanso los dos equipos trataron de subir la intensidad defensiva. Le iba bien así hasta que llegó otro momento crítico con el despegue de los helenos, 56-49 a 4:40 para el final del tercer cuarto. Volvió Mara y España ajustó más el juego interior. Su presencia condiciona mucho la defensa del rival. Pero Grecia estaba lanzada y parecía eufórica. Cuatro puntos de Toliopoulos (un triple y un tiro libre), colocaron de nuevo la máxima para el equipo local, 67-58, cuando el tercer acto llegaba a su fin. Grecia empezaba a creer en ganar el partido y España tenía de nuevo que remontar nueve puntos (13-4 fue la anterior), pero ahora sólo con un cuarto por delante. La máxima de Grecia aumentó hasta los 12 puntos por el triple de Bazinas cuando al cuarto le quedaban 7:20 para expirar. Para entonces Grecia ya había endurecido el partido y lo empezó a ensuciar. Se maneja mucho mejor ahí y España empezó a caer en la trampa con algunas pérdidas absurdas (se dejó hasta 20 posesiones perdiendo balones). Tyler Dorsey (Ntorsey en griego), otra vez anotador contra España, enfrió el primer intento de reacción de la selección con una gran canasta, 75-64 a 5:31. Un triple de Saint-Supéry y un robo con canasta de Parra metieron de nuevo en el partido a la selección de Mateo, 75-69, un minuto justo después. España creció en intensidad y un par de buenas acciones de Saint-Supéry y Parra acercaron a la selección, 75-73, cuando apareció de nuevo Dorsey con un triple, 78-73 a 3:17. Pero España, con una gran mejora en su juego, había introducido las dudas a los griegos que empezaron a fallar en ataque y a no guardar su balance. Otra canasta de Parra, gran partido el suyo, colocó el 78-76 a 2:46. Spanoulis se desesperaba en la banda, y a veces, muchas, dentro de la pista. Otro triple de Dorsey (siempre aparece contra España), levantó al OAKA. Pradilla logró dos de los tres tiros que tuvo y Mitoglou volvió a producir al triple (84-78 a 1:25). Llegó el desenlace. Triple de Cárdenas y luego mal ataque de Grecia que propicia la canasta completamente solo de Pradilla (84-83). Grecia falló su ataque y España el suyo con un triple de Saint-Supéry que no tocó ni aro. Quedaban 15 segundos por delante. Dos libres de Dorsey colocaron el 86-83 con una posesión para España, 14 segundos. Grecia decidió defender el tiro de tres... y le salió mal. Juancho Hernangómez, un héroe en el OAKA y en Atenas, se encargó de golpear las opciones griegas con un triple desde la parte alta de la zona. El tiro de Dorsey al final no entró y mando el partido al tiempo extra. En la prórroga llegaron los mejores minutos de Cárdenas. Ya lo hizo bien al final del tiempo regular, pero fue el encargo de guiar a España en los cinco minutos extras con canastas, robos y asistencias. Y llegó la polémica del partido. Un rebote cogido por Mara acabó en falta al zaragozano y antideportiva por un braceo del jugador español en una decisión cuando menos muy rigurosa. Era la quinta de Mara, decisivo en el partido. Los dos equipos aprovecharon los tiros libres (97-94 a 2:36) y Grecia convirtió su posesión extra con Mitoglou (99-94). Quedaba un mundo por delante. Parra anotó dos libres con otra jugada polémica, una falta sobre el tirador que quizá no existió. Pero España falló el tiro extra por el rebote en ataque (101-97 a 1:12). En los últimos segundos Grecia se apoyó en los tiros libres para mantener una ventaja que España redujo a dos puntos a falta de 19 segundos 107-105, con un triple de Darío Brizuela que anotó 8 puntos en el tramo final. Un tres contra uno contra Dorsey y el robo de Parra acabó con la falta del estadounidense. El jugador del Barça anotó sólo uno (107-106, a 10 segundos). La falta sobre Toliopoulos surtió su efecto, solo un libre del griego. En el ataque siguiente Brizuela no pudo siquiera tirar ante la defensa de Calathes y España perdió, 108-106.

images.caption: Aday Mara trata de lanzar a canasta en el partido ante Grecia. EFE.

articles.title: Gabriel Jesus pasa el reconocimiento médico: mañana será jugador del Barça
articles.standfirst: El brasileño, que estará esta noche en el palco del Spotify Camp Nou, refuerza el ataque culé
articles.summary: El brasileño, que estará esta noche en el palco del Spotify Camp Nou, refuerza el ataque culé
articles.body: Gabriel Jesus llegó esta tarde a Barcelona y ya superó el reconocimiento médico por el Barça, paso previo a la confirmación de su incorporación al conjunto azulgrana. El futbolista brasileño estará esta noche junto a su familia en el palco del Spotify Camp Nou, en el partido de LaLiga contra el Rayo. El Barcelona y el Arsenal llegaron en las últimas horas a un acuerdo para el traspaso de Gabriel Jesus, de 29 años. La operación se cerró en 10 millones de euros más variables y el exjugador del City, que ha festejado 127 goles con los dos equipos de la Premier, firmará por dos temporadas más una opcional. Pero la firma estaba pendiente de la revisión médica: el delantero brasileño, que puede jugar en las tres posiciones de ataque, sufrió una grave lesión hace unos años. Padeció una rotura del ligamento cruzado anterior en la rodilla izquierda en enero de 2025. Ya está totalmente recuperado, pero el Barcelona quiso confirmar que su articulación está en perfecto estado antes de oficializar la operación. El profesional, no obstante, ya aseguró al aterrizar en la Ciudad Condal que puede competir al máximo nivel. "Mi rodilla está perfecta", comentó. "Estoy muy contento por estar aquí", aseveró también de forma escueta. Con la llegada de Gabriel Jesus, que tenía contrato con el Arsenal hasta junio de 2027, Flick ve reforzado su ataque tras las salidas de Robert Lewandowski y Ferran Torres. La idea principal era firmar a Julián Álvarez, pero la negativa del Atlético a favorecer su traspaso al Spotify Camp Nou frustró su llegada. Desde el club culé, no obstante, no se descarta firmar al argentino en otras ventanas de fichajes, y por ese motivo vigilarán el fair play para no sobrepasarse. Una vez que el brasileño, que suma 123 encuentros con el Arsenal y participó en 236 con el City, pasó el reconocimiento médico, ahora las dos entidades se centran en el intercambio de documentos. La idea del club catalán, si esta gestión no se demora, es presentarlo pronto, ya mañana o el miércoles, para que se sume cuanto antes a los entrenamientos con Flick.

articles.title: World Cup: Joshua Kushner express regret in involvement in scrapped private investment plan
articles.summary: Venture capitalist Joshua Kushner says he would not have got involved in Fifa president Gianni Infantino's scrapped plan to sell off stakes in the World Cup if he had known how the football world reacted.
articles.body:
Venture capitalist Joshua Kushner, who was set to be the lead investor in Fifa president Gianni Infantino's scrapped plan to sell off stakes in the World Cup, says he now regrets joining the proposal.

In his first public comments since the now-shelved Fifa Forward Enterprise (FFE) scheme sparked a major crisis for the governing body, Kushner said: "Had we known what this would devolve into, we would not have gotten involved".

He added he had "failed to appreciate the political dynamics of global football".

However, he also defended the proposal, saying, "we stand behind the motivations of FFE", and that its intention "was to direct more capital and equity equally" among Fifa's 211 member associations.

Thrive Eternal, a firm founded by Kushner, who is the brother of US President Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared, had held talks with Infantino about heading up a $4.2bn (£3.1bn) investment in 20% of a new Fifa commercial subsidiary, before the idea was abandoned days after it was revealed in July amid a huge backlash.

Division, drama and power - what next for Infantino and Uefa?

Is football AI-proof? Why tech investors wanted a slice of the World Cup

Uefa preparing criminal legal action against Infantino

Kushner's comments come just days after Uefa asked a court in New York to approve subpoenas for testimony and documents from both the American billionaire and Thrive as it considers lodging a criminal complaint against Infantino in Switzerland.

European football's governing body Uefa has led the rebellion against the Fifa president, who is facing calls to stand down.

In a statement, Kushner said: "Money in football has historically been concentrated amongst a small group of countries.

"The idea behind FFE was to direct more capital and equity equally amongst all 211 member countries, providing significantly more investment to underdeveloped nations to nurture local talent, support grassroots football, enhance the fan experience, and ultimately grow the global game everywhere.

"It was an idea that every member association would vote on, not an obligation or determination.

"While we stand behind the motivations of FFE, we failed to appreciate the political dynamics of global football, and the lengths some would go to. Thrive has a long track record of being a partner to all constituents. Had we known what this would devolve into, we would not have gotten involved."

In late July, shortly before scrapping the plan, Fifa said, "Thrive Eternal...is expected to lead the proposed investor group for FFE", claiming it would have seen the funding distributed to each national association for the 2027-2030 cycle increase from £5.9m to £14.7m.

As well as Kushner, Uefa has asked for the disclosure of documents from two Fifa businesses in the US and American financier Greg Maffei, who was a key adviser on the deal.

While Uefa says neither Kushner nor Maffei are anticipated defendants in any legal proceedings, it claims the pair first discussed the FFE concept in July 2025 and that Infantino had "been discussing the underlying concept with Kushner for nearly a year before the terms sheet was ultimately signed."

Its lawyers also argue the World Cup was deliberately undervalued at around £15bn, which it says is "a figure that was neither the product of an open, competitive auction, nor tested by any independent valuer". It claims Infantino failed to consult Fifa's hierarchy over the plan.

Kushner has recently agreed a deal to buy basketball's Los Angeles Lakers for a record $12.5bn (£9.3bn).

articles.title: El Burgos perdona y se deja dos puntos ante un buen Sanse
articles.standfirst: Primer empate de ambos tras neutralizar Carrera y Gorosabel los goles de Curro Sánchez, de penalti, y Álex Forés
articles.summary: Primer empate de ambos tras neutralizar Carrera y Gorosabel los goles de Curro Sánchez, de penalti, y Álex Forés
articles.body: Burgos y Real Sociedad B sellaron con tablas en El Plantío un partido de máxima igualdad y alternativas marcado por el reencuentro del actual técnico burgalés, Sergio Francisco, con su antiguo equipo. Tanto los locales, que se adelantaron dos veces, como el filial, que igualó otras tantas, suman su primera igualada del curso. Al descanso ya se llegó con tablas en el marcador. Curro Sánchez abrió el marcador de penalti por mano de Agote a instancias del VAR, mientras Carrera puso el empate al remachar desde cerca la asistencia de Dani Díaz tras una impresionante contra del 7 del filial. El propio Carrera ya había tenido antes dos buenas ocasiones, pero la primera la estrelló en el poste de cabeza tras un córner de Dani, mientras la segunda la mandó fuera, solo ante Cantero. Por parte local Álex Forés también pudo marcar con un disparo que entre Fraga y el larguero desviaron, mientras se reclamó otro posible penalti de Garro a Llabrés. En la reanudación Ibai Aguirre fue el primero en probar fortuna, pero Cantero estuvo muy atento a detener su peligroso disparo. Fue la antesala a los dos goles que se sucedieron en apenas siete minutos, ya que Álex Forés, que había visto antes cómo le anulaban otro tanto por fuera de juego, volvió a adelantar al Burgos al rematar desde cerca el despeje defectuoso de Fraga a disparo de Llabrés, mientras Gorosabel cabeceó el rechace de Cantero tras un córner para empatar de nuevo el partido. Sergio Francisco movió el banquillo con las entradas de Mollejo y el ex realista Karrikaburu, que debutó con el Burgos, pero el equipo no consiguió generar peligro suficiente. Eso sí, en el añadido David González llegó a marcar el que podía haber sido el gol de la victoria, pero el colegiado Iosu Galech volvió a anular el tanto por una falta previa de Mollejo sobre Fraga. Así, el Burgos tuvo que conformarse con un empate en un encuentro en el que llegó a mandar dos veces.

articles.title: Iliman Ndiaye: Manchester City agree £65m deal for Everton forward
articles.summary: Manchester City agree a deal worth a minimum £60m to sign Iliman Ndiaye from Everton.
articles.body:
Manchester City have agreed a deal worth up to £65m to sign Iliman Ndiaye from Everton.

The clubs reached an agreement on a deal worth a guaranteed £60m plus a further £5m in add-ons for the Senegal winger.

The news comes after Tottenham agreed deals with Everton on Friday night for Ndiaye to join the London club, with Richarlison moving the other way in a separate transfer.

However, sources are indicating Richarlison failed to agree personal terms with former club Everton, who are understood to have made a £35m offer for the Brazil forward.

As a result, Tottenham have been unable to proceed with the Ndiaye transfer.

In an emotional statement on Instagram on Monday, Richarlison said: "After everything I've been through in the last few years, I've decided that never again will anyone decide my future for me.

"If they reach an agreement between Spurs and Everton, I will return to my beloved club.

"My intention was to go back to the place where I was very happy, yes, but the negotiations happened only in the way certain people wanted, and it will no longer be like that.

"Despite all this turmoil, I am under contract at Spurs and will remain at the club's disposal."

Tottenham are now in talks to sign Chelsea winger Mykhailo Mudryk on a season-long loan .

Manchester City's deal for Ndiaye comes after an £80m move for Liverpool forward Cody Gakpo looked set to collapse on Monday.

City had opened talks with Liverpool over a deal for the Netherlands international, with the Reds willing to sell Gakpo, providing they could sign a replacement.

Liverpool completed the signing of France forward Bradley Barcola from Paris St-Germain for a fee worth up to £123m on Monday, but want another attacking player if Gakpo were to leave.

The Anfield club had targeted moves for Brighton's Yankuba Minteh and Crystal Palace's Ismaila Sarr but the valuation of both players has proved problematic.

Liverpool are now expected to keep Gakpo, 27, unless they are able to revive a deal for a new winger before Tuesday's deadline.

articles.title: Iliman Ndiaye transfer news: Man City agree £65m deal for Everton winger as Tottenham turn attention to Mykhailo Mudryk
articles.summary: Manchester City advancing in talks with Everton to sign winger Iliman Ndiaye; City had £80m bid for Liverpool's Cody Gakpo rejected on Monday; Spurs had been in talks over Ndiaye and have turned attention to Chelsea's Mykhailo Mudryk
articles.body:
With contact already established between City and Everton over Jack Grealish, discussions have moved swiftly.

City's deal is broken up into a £60m guaranteed payment plus £5m in bonuses.

Richarlison's reluctance to make a final decision on a move to Everton held up Spurs' advanced talks involving Ndiaye that had been ongoing since yesterday.

It means Tottenham are looking to alternative targets and have started talks with Chelsea about a loan for Mykhailo Mudryk .

Earlier on Monday, Liverpool rejected City's £80m bid for Cody Gakpo.

Sky Sports News understands Liverpool are concerned about their chances of bringing in a replacement for the Dutchman.

Manchester City want to sign a wide forward and a central midfielder before the window closes.

Manchester City allowed Savio and Omar Marmoush to join Tottenham earlier month, reducing Enzo Maresca's options on the wing.

City did not name a winger on their bench in Friday's win over Crystal Palace and started with Phil Foden - who Enzo Maresca admitted is not a winger - out wide at Selhurst Park.

Liverpool signed Bradley Barcola from Paris Saint-Germain on Monday while Victor Munoz arrived from Osasuna earlier this summer.

Spurs also targeted Gakpo in this window before signing Savio and Marmoush.

articles.title: LSU's Funny 4+ Post Goes Viral amid Saga Surrounding Jayden Daniels' No. 5 Jersey
articles.summary: LSU is counting down the days until their season opener against Clemson on Saturday, and they mysteriously skipped right on past the No. 5 in those posts.
articles.body:
LSU is counting down the days until their season opener against Clemson on Saturday, and they mysteriously skipped right on past the No. 5 in those posts.

The joke comes at the expense of Washington Commanders quarterback and former LSU player Jayden Daniels, who sent a cease-and-desist to the school after it allowed sophomore cornerback DJ Pickett to wear No. 5, which Daniels wore at the school during his Heisman Trophy season.

While LSU never formally retired his number, the school hadn't fielded a No. 5 on its roster since Daniels last played there in 2023.

"Jayden made it clear that he did not want his number given to another player, and he believed his wishes would be respected," a statement from Daniels' spokesperson read. "His Heisman Trophy-winning season and everything he accomplished on and off the field cemented his place in LSU history. To see his number given to another player is incredibly disappointing and feels like a failure to honor the significance of what Jayden accomplished at LSU."

And now it's fodder for the school's social media admin.

articles.title: El Málaga, cerca de firmar a Juan Berrocal para su defensa
articles.standfirst: El club sigue sondeando el mercado de fichajes
articles.summary: El club sigue sondeando el mercado de fichajes
articles.body: El Málaga CF acelera en el mercado y va a por Juan Berrocal. El conjunto blanquiazul se ha lanzado en las últimas horas a por el central del Getafe CF y la operación estaría muy cerca de concretarse. La información, adelantada por Matteo Moretto, ha podido ser confirmada por este medio. El futbolista jerezano pasará reconocimiento médico este martes antes de convertirse, si todo sigue el curso previsto, en el tercer refuerzo que prepara el club en el tramo final del mercado, después de Jens Cajuste y Adam Aznou. La necesidad de reforzar el eje de la zaga ha ganado peso después de las primeras jornadas de competición. El Málaga ha detectado ciertas dudas en esa posición y ha decidido acudir al mercado para incorporar a un futbolista con experiencia en la máxima categoría. La operación por Aznou, que finalmente tendrá ficha del filial y todo apunta a que lucirá el dorsal 39, ya está encarrilada, mientras que el club trabaja en paralelo para cerrar las otras dos incorporaciones. Berrocal, de 27 años, regresaría así a LaLiga después de su etapa en el Getafe y de su reciente experiencia en la MLS. El central militó durante la última temporada y media como cedido en el Atlanta United, donde disputó 12 encuentros durante la pasada campaña. El conjunto estadounidense disponía de una opción de compra al término de la cesión, pero finalmente decidió no ejecutarla. El defensa andaluz acumula además 19 partidos en Primera División durante la temporada 2024/25, una experiencia que encaja con el perfil que busca el Málaga para apuntalar su defensa. Actualmente, Berrocal se encontraba entrenándose al margen del grupo en el Getafe después de quedar fuera de los planes de José Bordalás para este curso. Ahora, el Málaga aparece como su próximo destino y la operación podría quedar resuelta en las próximas horas.

articles.standfirst: El mexicano sale cedido con opción de compra
articles.summary: El mexicano sale cedido con opción de compra
articles.body: El delantero mexicano Santiago Giménez fue presentado este lunes como nuevo jugador del Oporto, con el que jugará cedido por el Milan. En un comunicado, el Oporto indicó que la cesión se extenderá hasta el final de la temporada actual, tras lo cual tendrá la opción de adquirir al internacional azteca por 18 millones de euros. Sin embargo, la compra de Giménez podría volverse obligatoria si se cumplen "ciertos objetivos deportivos", según la nota del club portugués, que, no obstante, no especifica cuáles serán. En declaraciones a los medios del Oporto, Santiago Giménez dijo que su llegada al club será "una etapa que aportará mucho" a su trayectoria como futbolista. "Fue una decisión muy importante, porque quiero seguir escribiendo mi propia historia y sentirme importante", señaló. Giménez, de 25 años, se une al campeón de Portugal en busca de minutos de juego y goles, después de haber marcado solo siete en la temporada y media que jugó con el Milan. Las estadísticas de Giménez con la camiseta 'rossonera' difieren de las de su etapa en el Feyenoord, en el que anotó 65 goles en 105 partidos, lo que contribuyó a la conquista de una Liga, una Copa y una Supercopa de Países Bajos.

articles.title: Nottingham Forest: Omari Hutchinson joins AC Milan on season-long loan
articles.summary: AC Milan complete the signing of Omari Hutchinson on loan from Nottingham Forest until the end of the season.
articles.body:
AC Milan have signed Omari Hutchinson on loan from Nottingham Forest until the end of the season.

The seven-time European champions will have the option to make the forward's move to the San Siro permanent at the end of the campaign.

Hutchinson's temporary exit from Forest comes 12 months after completing a £37.5m transfer from Ipswich Town.

Last season at the City Ground, he made only 17 Premier League starts under four different managers.

Hutchinson came through the ranks at Chelsea before moving to Arsenal and signing his first professional contract in 2020.

He returned to Stamford Bridge in 2022 and made two appearances for the Blues before joining Ipswich in 2023.

After initially joining the Tractor Boys on loan in 2023, Hutchinson's move was made permanent 12 months later after he helped them win promotion to the Premier League.

Hutchinson, who was part of the England Under-21 side that won the European Championship in 2025, will wear the number 20 shirt for Milan this season.

articles.title: Takeaways from Oklahoma's official depth chart release for Week 1
articles.summary: What to take away as OU releases depth chart for first game.
articles.body:
The Oklahoma Sooners open up the 2026 season against the UTEP Miners on Friday night, and OU has officially released the first depth chart of the year for the season opener.

While fifth-year head coach Brent Venables and his coaching staff didn't provide us with very many surprises for Week 1, there's still plenty to take away, even though the depth chart will certainly change as the season progresses.

Today, we'll take a look at each position on the depth chart, to identify the key names to watch in Game 1 of the new season.

No surprises here. Mateer is the no-doubt starter for the Sooners, while Newbauer and Bentley have competed to back him up. Newbauer has reportedly been impressive in fall camp, so look for him to truly be QB2 in 2026, though he's currently listed as a co-backup.

It looks like Avant and Robinson will be the primary backs for the Sooners to open the season. Avant has been healthy since he got to OU, so he gets the nod here. Robinson certainly has a chance to become the feature back if he plays well. Blaylock has been banged up this preseason, which should allow Hatton to take on a larger role early on. If he excels, it'll be tough to keep the youngster off the field.

The only WR spot with co-starters is the X position, where Livingstone and Thomas will continue to battle for snaps on the outside. Livingstone was one of the biggest portal additions OU made this offseason, while Thomas is hoping to be a homegrown wideout that gets into the mix. Carter is a reliable target who should play a lot this season.

Sategna is the top wideout for the Sooners, and he's a feature part of the offense from the slot. His big-play ability and relationship with Mateer will benefit OU again this year. Alleyne and Jordan will continue to compete for the remaining slot wideout snaps, and they should both get a lot of second-half run against the Miners.

Oklahoma really likes Harris, and he earned the starting job on the outside, despite missing spring ball and the early portion of fall camp. The incoming transfer was that good in the limited opportunities he got. Choice took a step forward this offseason, and he's certainly a player that will factor into the rotation at wide receiver this year.

Hansen and Beers are both veteran incoming transfers, and they'll start as co-starters at tight end. Hansen's size and blocking ability make him an attractive option, while Beers' receiving ability is a nice complement. Van Dorselaer is a younger player that OU really likes, and Washington has seemingly emerged from Oklahoma's returning TE options.

If he's healthy, there's no doubt that Fasusi is OU's starting left tackle. He's the biggest name on the offensive line, and did some really impressive things last year as a true freshman. Joseph and Hinton will be behind him, as both players transferred into the program during the offseason.

Pierre-Louis held on to his starting spot at left guard in fall camp, and he'll add a physical edge to the left side of the line. Ozaeta is a veteran who will see a lot of time at multiple positions, but perhaps not as much on the left side. It looks like Hutton has emerged from the pack to be the third-stringer, as he enters his second year at OU.

This is the position that has gotten all of the headlines this fall. After starter Jake Maikkula got hurt, the Sooners shuffled the offensive line a bit to cover the center spot. That means Fodje, who was projected as the starter at right guard, will now begin the year at center until Maikkula's return. Nitta is the backup who will absolutely need to stay ready, and Allen is a veteran player who has spent five years at OU.

Photos of Oklahoma Sooners OL Ryan Fodje

Because of the movement at center, it appears both Ozaeta and Best will continue to compete to be the starting right guard. Ozaeta is a good option because of his experience, but Best has been really impressive this fall, forcing his way into the OL conversation. Fodje may take over this role when Maikkula returns to play center, but for now, it's Ozaeta and Best here. Hollenbeck is a second-year player who is the third-stringer at this spot.

Harris was penciled in as the starting right tackle when he transferred to OU, and he'll look to use his SEC experience to provide stability on the right side. Schmitt is his backup, meaning the Sooners have really liked their true freshmen linemen. Hinton will also provide depth at right tackle, as he's the third-stringer at both tackle spots.

At one of the defensive tackle spots, Stone is the obvious starter, as he's garnering plenty of hype heading into the season. His potential is sky-high, and OU needs him to be a star this year. Thomas and Smith will compete for reps behind him, and important role as the Sooners will rotate up front. Carrington is a true freshman who should also see the opportunity to get on the field as well.

Best photos of David Stone with the Oklahoma Sooners

At the other defensive tackle spot, Jackson will be the starter for the third straight year, and he's a huge piece of what the Sooners do up front on defense. Wilson and Smith are two homegrown players who will see a lot of playing time this year, and OU is relying upon both of them this season. They're a big part of the future at DT.

After his breakout season in 2025, Wein is a no-doubt starter on the edge for the Sooners. He's risen from depth piece to star at defensive end, and he's another feature name for this OU defense. Gilmore has won the backup job on the left side, and he'll look to replicate Wein's career in Norman. Ozowalu is a UTSA transfer who should also see some time in 2026.

This is the only starting position on the whole defense that still looks up for grabs. Adebawore and Okoye will both play a lot of football this season, as they compete to earn more reps on the edge opposite Wein. The Sooners need one of both of them to become a game-wrecker this year. Kreul, a true freshman, was one of the gems of OU's most recent recruiting class, and he should play a lot against UTEP and could break into the mix later in the year.

No questions at the weakside linebacker spot. Lewis is the longest-tenured Sooner, and he's been with Venables since the beginning. Lewis has started since midway through the 2023 season, and his return for one last ride is huge for OU. Nesta has earned the backup role, and he'll certainly play a lot for Oklahoma this season.

At middle linebacker, Heinecke's eligibility victory in court this spring gives OU a bona fide field general at the second level. He's been at Oklahoma for five years, and has risen from special-teamer to star in Norman. Sullivan will obviously play a ton at multiple positions, but will see some time in the middle. Bathurst has emerged from the rest of the pack to earn the third-team spot as a true freshman

Oklahoma Sooners linebacker Owen Heinecke Photos

Venables and the Sooners don't normally play a strongside linebacker, instead opting for the Cheetah position, which is a hybrid linebacker and defensive back. However, when the Sooners want to go a little bigger and play three true linebackers at the same time instead of a true Cheetah, it'll be Sullivan who takes the field first. The incoming transfer has been impressive since he got to OU. Nesta is also in the mix, as he'll earn his first big-time snaps as a Sooner this season.

Powers will be OU's starting Cheetah this season, as he was the backup in this spot a season ago. Though it looks like a lot of different players will see time at Cheetah, it's Powers who should get the lion's share of the snaps, at least early on. Newcombe is another option here, as is Bauer, a true freshman who didn't get to Norman until the summer. When Venables wants to play a little more speed and coverage at Cheetah with five true defensive backs, look for these three guys to see the field.

After starting as a true freshman in 2025, Guillory is back for his second year as one of the starting cornerbacks in Norman. He flashed immense potential and should only get better as his career progresses. It'll be Haynes and Fields behind him, as the Sooners will likely rotate cornerbacks a lot this season. Both guys will need to be ready early and often

Bowen is healthy to open the season this go-around, and he's been an excellent CB for the Sooners ever since he got to campus. Johnson is a veteran who will continue to play a lot, and his athleticism is a big plus for Oklahoma. Fields could also play on this side as well, as it looks like the Sooners have five cornerbacks they feel good about at this time.

Bowen is another multi-year starter for the OU defense, and he's the alpha dog of the Sooner secondary in 2026. His leadership and ability to do just about everything are huge for Venables' defense. Robinson will play a lot this fall in his second year as a Sooner, and Ford has been impressive as a true freshman.

Boganowski steps into the other starting safety spot, and the Sooners like his physicality in the defensive backfield. Robinson is the clear No. 3 safety, and he'll be on the field a lot this year. Jandreau is a true freshman that has played well this fall, and DeQuasie gives OU a veteran depth option at safety, helping to anchor a room that is very young overall.

No surprises at this spot. Sandell was one of the nation's best kickers last year, and he's back to help power OU's special teams. Evans and Rudd will compete to be his backup, a battle that may last into next season to determine the new starter.

Punter was one of the only true position battles in fall camp, and it looks like Miller has defended his starting spot to begin the year. Ulrich is also a really solid punter option, and last year showed us that this battle can flip midseason if needed.

Anderson is back for one last year as OU's starting long snapper, and he's one of the nation's best. Freeman is waiting in the wings behind him, and he'll be ready to take over next season.

Ulrich will remain Oklahoma's holder on extra points and field goals, as he was a key member of a unit that executed very well in 2025. Miller is the second option at this spot, which is just the inverse of the punter depth chart.

Sandell will handle the kickoff duties again for the Sooners, with Rudd and Evans again competing behind him. It looks like Oklahoma has identified its top two backup kickers on the roster if something were to happen to Sandell this season.

After returning just two total kickoffs last season, the Sooners will dig into their running back room for the kick returner slots. Avant is the headliner, as he has experience in the role, and Hatton has emerged as the player who will join him on the back line.

Sategna will again be returning punts for the Sooners in 2026, and he was a revelation in this spot a year ago. The Sooners will use a couple other members of the wide receiver room as the backup options behind Sategna, as Jordan and Harris would be the next men up if they are needed.

articles.title: Official | Eintracht Frankfurt sign preferred defensive reinforcement Lilian Brassier (26)
articles.summary: Eintracht Frankfurt have officially completed the signing of French defender Lilian Brassier from Stade Rennes, adding an experienced left-footed center-back...
articles.body:
Eintracht Frankfurt have officially completed the signing of French defender Lilian Brassier from Stade Rennes, adding an experienced left-footed center-back to a defensive unit that endured another difficult afternoon in Saturday's Bundesliga opener. The 26-year-old has signed a long-term contract through 2031. Sky Germany reports Frankfurt will pay Rennes an initial €8.5m transfer fee, with potential bonuses capable of increasing the final sum.

Kicker places the overall valuation of the deal at approximately €10m.

The move had been expected for several days. Get German Football News reported on Friday that Eintracht had reached an agreement to sign Brassier as part of a wider defensive reshuffle . Negotiations with Rennes ultimately took longer than Frankfurt initially hoped, preventing Brassier from arriving before the opening Bundesliga weekend. The desired reinforcement finally arrives not a moment too soon.

Brassier arrives after another difficult defensive afternoon

Frankfurt opened the 2026/27 Bundesliga campaign with a 3-3 draw away at Union Berlin on Saturday. Younes Ebnoutalib's hat-trick appeared to have placed Adi Hütter's side in control at 3-1, but Frankfurt failed to protect the two-goal advantage. The striker's individual achievement nevertheless could not conceal another concerning defensive performance.

Frankfurt conceded all three Union goals from set-piece situations and increasingly struggled to deal with the hosts' direct pressure as the match progressed. The problems were particularly noteworthy given the defensive concerns that had already emerged during preseason. Get German Football News' 2026/27 Eintracht Frankfurt tactical preview highlighted the substantial reconstruction required in Hütter's back line.

Young summer signing Otávio also endured an uneven preseason, while Nnamdi Collins has dealt with injury problems. Frankfurt accordingly entered the final phase of the transfer window intent on adding another experienced defender. Brassier now supplies precisely that profile.

Brassier set to replace Theate on left side

The Frenchman's arrival directly follows Arthur Theate's departure for Bologna. Brassier now appears the natural successor to the Belgian. Both are left-footed defenders capable of operating centrally or covering the left side, although Brassier brings a somewhat different physical profile. The defender is expected primarily to compete for the left center-back position alongside captain Robin Koch in Hütter's preferred back four, but could initially slide in at left-back for Bundesliga debutant Keita Kosugi, who endured a questionable first start.

Brassier arrives with substantial experience in French football. The Rennes academy graduate has already accumulated 161 Ligue 1 appearances despite being only 26. After beginning his development with Rennes, Brassier spent the 2019/20 campaign on loan at Valenciennes before moving to Brest. He established himself there as a regular and eventually accumulated 108 competitive appearances for the Breton club. A subsequent spell with Olympique Marseille produced another 12 appearances before Brassier returned to Rennes in January 2025.

He quickly re-established himself with his formative club. Brassier made 27 league appearances last season as Rennes finished sixth and secured Europa League qualification. He departs having accumulated 41 senior competitive appearances for the club that originally developed him. The Frankfurt move will constitute his first club experience outside France.

SGE Board Member for Sport Markus Krösche specifically emphasized the qualities Frankfurt believe Brassier can add in a club statement.

"With Lilian Brassier, we have been able to sign a physically strong and fast defender who contests duels with great intensity while also possessing significant dynamism," Krösche said. "We are convinced that Lilian will provide our defense with additional stability and quality."

articles.title: Aston Villa vs. Arsenal player ratings: Live grades for Gunners, Villains in 2026 Premier League match
articles.summary: The defending Premier League champions look to keep things moving at the start of the season as Arsenal navigate their first road trip of the campaign with a...
articles.body:
The defending Premier League champions look to keep things moving at the start of the season as Arsenal navigate their first road trip of the campaign with a visit to Aston Villa on Monday.

The Gunners have begun the season in excellent fashion, silencing Manchester City with a 3-0 win in the Community Shield before a victory of the same scoreline against newly-promoted Coventry City to begin league play.

Aston Villa, meanwhile, were thrashed by Brighton 4-0 to open their top flight circuit, still in a state of transition from a busy summer transfer window as Unai Emery looks to impart his specialised tactics on a host of new players.

The Sporting News brings you a full list of player ratings for the match, analysing both team's individual performances from the opening kickoff to the final whistle.

Location: Villa Park (Birmingham, England) Referee: Jarred Gillett

Aston Villa (4-2-3-1, right to left): 1. Z. Suzuki (GK) — 2. M. Cash, 3. V. Lindelof, 14. P. Torres, 22. I. Maatsen — 8. B. Kamara, 6. R. Barkley — 7. J. McGinn, 10. E. Buendia, 53. G. Hemmings — 11. N. Jackson.

Arsenal (4-3-3, right to left): 1. Raya (GK) — 4. B. White, 3. Y. Mosquera, 6. Gabriel, 33. R. Calafiori — 8. M. Odegaard, 49. M. Lewis-Skelly, 41. D. Rice — 7. B. Saka, 29. K. Havertz, 17. C. Tzolis (Eze, 46').

Had nothing to do in the first half, as Aston Villa failed to secure a shot on target. Good in possession in his own half, but struggled with long deliveries.

This section will be updated as the match progresses and the player looks to have an impact on the game.

Ben White got the start at right-back over former Aston Villa defender Ezri Konsa, who is yet to make his Arsenal debut.

Caused Aston Villa some problems in an inverted full-back role tucking into midfield.

Right center-back: Cristhian Mosquera — 7

Mosquera is starting in place of the injured William Saliba for as long as the Frenchman remains sidelined by his back injury. Great start to the match on both ends, especially providing danger on corners not just on the initial delivery, but also in recycling possession to keep the pressure on.

Hardly put a foot wrong on the ball, but did occasionally get lost with Aston Villa counter-attacking. For the most part, held firm on his side of the field, and was exceptional in the build-up.

Muscled off the ball early on by Boubacar Kamara (definitely a foul, but wasn't called). A bit scatterbrained as is his style, but did manage to provide occasional danger.

Provided great energy in the attacking half through the first 45 minutes, creating multiple chances for Arsenal. Fed Kai Havertz in the 14th minute for his missed shot, although he pulled the trigger just a split second too late which saw the German leaning slightly offside.

Central midfielder: Myles Lewis-Skelly — 7

With Declan Rice doing more of the adventurous possessional work, Lewis-Skelly was assured in the middle.

Heavily involved throughout the first 25 minutes, to mixed results. His efforts to play long didn't quite work out, but he was still a major factor in Arsenal's possession. Was excellent on set pieces, both delivering corners from his side, and got on the end of one by Saka in the 26th minute that he headed just over the crossbar, a very good chance.

A menace to defend throughout the first half, as he got on the ball repeatedly in the attacking third, including multiple penalty-area touches.

Missed a huge chance in the 14th minute from a tight angle, but was leaning just offside anyways. Delivered an excellent ball to Bukayo Saka in the 25th minute that nearly unlocked the Aston Villa defense but won a corner in the end.

Just seven touches in the first half, had very little influence on the match which saw neither team find a shot on target through the opening 45 minutes.

Relatively invisible through the first 20 minutes of the game, although he contributed some in the defensive half. Struggled to get by Matty Cash, and fouled the Aston Villa full-back midway through the first half that resulted in a booking.

Rightly hooked at halftime in favor of Eberechi Eze.

Entered in place of a struggling Christos Tzolis at halftime.

This section will be updated as the game progresses and Mikel Arteta brings players into the match off the bench.

This section will be updated with an evaluation of the Arsenal coaching performance after full-time once the match can be successfully processed in full.

Having earned a summer move to the Premier League after a strong performance in the 2026 FIFA World Cup for Japan, Suzuki has big shoes to fill, making his Aston Villa debut in place of the departed Emi Martinez.

Didn't have anything to do between the sticks in the first half as Arsenal failed to get a shot on target, and was mediocre on the ball.

Was everywhere throughout the first half, both at the back and up in possession. Did very well defending Christos Tzolis, and managed to get forward as well. Won a foul by Tzolis that saw the Arsenal winger booked 29 minutes in.

Defended bravely throughout the match, as he prevented Arsenal from building through the middle.

Struggled to have any influence in possession, with just 14 first-half touches.

Excellent defensively, routinely keeping Kai Havertz quiet throughout the first half.

On the ball, Torres was a mixed bag. His 22 touches made him the preferred defender to begin the build-up, but he only completed 11 of 17 first-half passes, which is extremely poor for a defender, especially considering only three of those misses were long.

Had tons of defending to do as he looked to keep a lid on Bukayo Saka with little success, but managed to get forward in transition at times. Saw a shot in the 27th minute go just wide. Nearly had the opener as a 43rd-minute cross was just out of reach, and it was surprising not to see him give it more of an effort on the run.

Absolutely mugged Riccardo Calafiori to create the chance that saw Emi Buendia strike the post. It was most definitely a foul, but credit to Kamara for staying with it and making something happen. Unfortunately, that led to more overtly physical play shortly after, which the referee was now wise to. Needed to show more in possession to have an impact on the match.

With new signing Leon Goretzka not quite up to speed yet, Ross Barkley got the start in midfield for Aston Villa.

Barkley was safe in possession, but his real starring role was defensively, where he routinely blew up Arsenal build-up or forced them out wide. He logged five first-half defensive contributions.

In classic John McGinn fashion, he displayed exceptional work rate from the opening whistle, winning fouls in midfield and tracking back to put in good defensive work in keeping Arsenal from going long.

Looked very bright in possession, combining with teammates when Aston Villa got forward. Struck the bar from long range with a sensational strike in the 12th minute.

Also contributed some defensively, and won some aerial duels as well. A great all-around performance, given Aston Villa struggled to maintain long spells of possession.

The 19-year-old had barely a sniff on the ball in the opening quarter of the match, as Emi Buendia was the main ball carrier in the build-up. Didn't do much with his 10 first-half touches.

The former Chelsea striker makes his Aston Villa debut, having joined from the London club this summer for €55 million, hoping to replace Ollie Watkins at the head of Unai Emery's specialised formation.

Through the first 20 minutes of the game, he was a complete non-factor, even as Aston Villa looked to work the ball forward both in transition and in possession.

articles.title: Raphinha, en modo arrollador e histórico: tercer partido seguido marcando
articles.standfirst: Ya suma cuatro goles
articles.summary: Ya suma cuatro goles
articles.body: El inicio de temporada de Raphinha está siendo espectacular. Contra el Rayo volvió a ver puerta, por tercer encuentro consecutivo, y entró en la elitista lista de futbolistas que han tenido un estreno de curso tan prometedor. El último fue Leo Messi. El internacional brasileño, de 29 años, marcó un doblete contra el Elche en el estreno liguero. Volvió a festejar un tanto contra el Athletic. Y esta noche, frente al Rayo, en el Spotify Camp Nou, fue el encargado de inaugurar el marcador para el Barça. Con su diana igualó, además, el gol inicial de Camello. Flick está apostando por exprofesional del Leeds de falso 9 y le está respondiendo a un nivel extraordinario. Ya suma cuatro goles en estos tres primeros encuentros. Gabriel Jesus, que vio el encuentro desde el palco tras pasar el reconocimiento médico, tendrá que pelear para arrebatarle el puesto de delantero centro. Raphinha suma ya cuatro goles en LaLiga y todo el curso pasado firmó 13 en el torneo nacional regular y 21 entre todas las competiciones. Su estreno de campaña está siendo abrumador. Con su tanto al Rayo, Raphinha encadena tres encuentros viendo puerta. Muy pocos jugadores del Barcelona han tenido un inicio de curso tan prometedor y triunfal. El último de ellos fue Leo Messi en 2020. También lo lograron profesionales de la talla de Etoo, Ibrahimovic, Cesc Fàbregas, Schuster, Stoichkov, Luis Enrique o Kubala, entre otros. El internacional brasileño se convirtió en el jugador número 15 que logra marcar en los tres primeros encuentros de LaLiga.

articles.title: USC eyeing 'increased attendance the rest of the season' after barren opener in Year 5 under Lincoln Riley
articles.summary: There were swaths of empty seats Saturday at the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum.
articles.body:
At Big Ten media days last month, Lincoln Riley pumped up USC as a program that's ready for liftoff , declaring that the Trojans are "more equipped than at any point in the previous few years" to compete for and win championships.

"That's not a hope or a wish," he added ahead of his fifth season as head coach. "Those are facts, and there's a lot of facts to back that up."

Back then, he referenced alignment and momentum, the latter of which was hardly reflected in the stands on Saturday.

USC, which has yet to make the College Football Playoff, opened the 2026 season in front of a reported 51,144 spectators. There actually appeared to be far fewer dotting the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum seats. Nevertheless, that's still the lowest recorded attendance total in the Riley era and the team's lowest since 2018, per USA Today .

The sight left a lot to be desired and instantly became a bigger talking point than USC taking care of business against the Mountain West's San Jose State to the tune of a 42-26 victory .

"We understand the factors that impacted Saturday's attendance," USC said in a statement to USA Today on Monday .

"We have high expectations and a premier home schedule this season, and we know the competitive advantage an electric Coliseum atmosphere can provide our program. We thank our fans who showed up Saturday and look forward to seeing increased attendance the rest of the season."

Among the factors the university alluded to in its statement is the weather. At the time of the game's noon local kickoff, the temperature was a sizzling 94 degrees. The real feel mark reportedly surged into triple digits. And the National Weather Service issued a heat advisory for L.A. County through 8 p.m. that day, according to ESPN , which noted that some fans left their seats to watch the game from shaded areas in the stadium.

Regardless, plenty of fans online have scrutinized the turnout, pointing out that the heat hasn't stopped droves of people attending college football games over the years, especially in the South.

Then there's the other part of the conversation: the opponent. USC has a loaded schedule. The Trojans have to play Oregon, Ohio State and Indiana. Their games against the Ducks and Buckeyes are at home. Quite simply, there are bigger matchups are on the horizon than an Aug. 29 date with San Jose State.

That reasoning hasn't slowed commentary, of course. After all, the Coliseum — an undeniably iconic college football venue — ushered in a crowd akin to one a middling spring game would draw.

"There is no way a human being at Southern Cal put out that pile of garbage," Finebaum said Monday, when reacting to USC's statement on ESPN's "First Take." "That had to be AI generated because no sane person at the University of Southern California would say that.

"And by the way, that 51,000 looked like about 25,000. I've been around sports a long time. When you have nobody at the game, you tend to exaggerate whatever you have."

USC hosts Fresno State and Louisiana before beginning Big Ten play on the road against Rutgers on Sept. 19. The Trojans' first marquee matchup is versus the Ducks on Sept. 26.
